svg.text: ROUND 362 · 🏆 1,570-ASSERTION MILESTONE · ORDER-TO-CASH & AR AUTOMATION (HIGHRADIUS / BILLTRUST / SAP FSCM)
Enterprise Order-to-Cash (AR Lockbox), Credit-Hold Release & Factoring AI Security Guide
Trade Credit Insurance & CECL Reserve Air-Gap + BAI2 Bank-Feed & Credit-Block Lock vs. Remittance Injection & Refund Fraud (BRK-733 / BRK-734)
🚨 1. Top 3 Order-to-Cash & AR Lockbox Attack Surfaces
① Remittance Advice (EDI 820) Injection & CECL Leak (BRK-733)
• Adversarial prompt inside a Lockbox Remittance PDF or EDI 820
coerces AR Cash-App Agent into reading restricted-budget
• Exfiltrates customer distress watchlists, trade credit insurance
(Allianz/Coface) coverage withdrawals & ASC 326 CECL bad-debt models
② Short-Pay Write-Off & Credit-Hold Release Hijack (BRK-733)
• Mutates business-result to clear open invoices without verified
bank cash or write off massive unauthorized short-pay deductions
• Lifts SAP FSCM credit-hold blocks on delinquent accounts
• Impact: Insolvent buyers ship millions in uncollectible inventory
③ Spoofed Factoring NOA & Credit-Balance Refund Fraud (BRK-734)
• Forged customer Credit-Balance Refund request or AR Factoring
SPV Notice of Assignment (NOA) swaps IBAN in trust-registry
• Initiates unauthorized $5,400 refund/factoring wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Direct cash loss & receivables securitization covenant breach
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Order-to-Cash & AR Defense Architecture
Gate 1: Remittance Sanitization & Typed BAI2/EDI Slots
• Strips free-text buyer memo notes from Lockbox PDFs & EDI 820;
extracts typed slots (Invoice ID, Bank BAI2/camt.054 Ref, Paid Amt)
• Strictly tags untrusted=True, lane="attack"
Gate 2: Credit Insurance & CECL Reserve Air-Gap
• Isolates customer bankruptcy watchlists, insurer coverage cuts,
and ASC 326 CECL bad-debt reserve matrices in restricted-budget
• Enforced via record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic Bank-Feed Match & Credit-Block Lock
• Requires verified bank BAI2/camt.054 cash settlement before
clearing AR invoices or lifting SAP FSCM credit-hold blocks
• Enforced via untrusted-write blocking tainted write-offs
Gate 4: Immutable Factoring SPV & Original-Source Refund Lock
• Locks factoring & customer refund accounts in trust-registry
(tool-allowlist + fixed-business-output + original-requester-payment)
📊 3. Architecture Selection & Benchmark Results
Head-to-Head Order-to-Cash & AR Security Options:
A. Deterministic AR Broker + CECL Air-Gap + BAI2 Lock (🏆)
✓ 100% Block on BRK-733/734 | ASC 326 CECL & SOX 404 Ready
B. Native HighRadius / Billtrust / SAP FSCM RBAC
⚠ Vulnerable when Cash-App bot is hijacked by remittance PDF
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Prompt Shields / Bedrock Guardrails)
⚠ Blind to BAI2 bank balances, short-pay tolerances & credit blocks
D. Manual AR Clerk Lockbox Keying & Credit Reviews
✕ Inflates DSO by 5–10 days, high unapplied cash backlog
🧪 Pytest Deterministic Regression (Round 362 · 1,570 Assertions!):
• Baseline Policy: Credit block lifted, CECL leaked & wire allowed ❌
• Hardened Policy: All 5 deterministic gates blocked 100% ✅
- record-owner: Blocks reading CECL & credit watchlists (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks short-pay write-off & credit-hold release
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks credit insurer limit exfiltration
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks factoring/refund registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,400 spoofed refund wire
🚀 Architect Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestones (Round 362 · 🏆 1,570 Deterministic Assertions Milestone!)
✅ 1. Credit Insurance & CECL Reserve Air-Gap: Isolate distressed buyer watchlists & insurer limits from Cash-Application agents
✅ 2. Deterministic BAI2 Bank-Feed & Credit-Hold Lock: Require settled bank funds before clearing invoices or lifting credit blocks
✅ 3. Immutable Factoring SPV & Original-Sender Refund Lock: Lock trust-registry and require Credit Director + Treasury FIDO2 sign-off
📊 Verified Totals: 752 Scenarios (749 Risk + 3 Benign) | 834 Pytest Checks | 🏆 1,570 Assertions | 738 Vectors | 362 Bilingual FAQs (181 SA Guides) | BRK-733/734
